ei.title: 브랜드화의 역할: 인지도를 통한 소비자의 위험 감소
ei.subject: 수능특강Light

fullPassage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both ①<u>benefit from branding</u>. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they ②<u>have experience</u> the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might ③<u>choose to stay</u> at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers ④<u>would recognise worldwide</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② have experience → have experienced: 'have + 과거분사'의 현재완료이므로 과거분사 experienced가 맞다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① benefit from branding: 복수 주어에 맞는 동사 benefit으로 정상

❌ ② have experience → have experienced: 'once they have ___ the brand'는 '일단 ~을 경험하고 나면'이라는 현재완료예요. 현재완료는 'have + 과거분사(p.p.)'이므로 명사·원형 experience가 아니라 과거분사 experienced가 맞아요 ←정답

✅ ③ choose to stay: 'might choose to stay(묵기로 선택할 수도 있다)'에서 to부정사로 정상

✅ ④ would recognise worldwide: 조동사 would 뒤 동사원형 recognise로 정상
det.tip: 현재완료 = have + 과거분사(p.p.). have experienced(O) / have experience(X)

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition ①<u>is an important feature</u>. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because ③<u>the traveller having a good indication</u> of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ having → has: 이 절(because ~)에는 동사가 필요하므로 -ing가 아닌 정동사 has가 맞다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① is an important feature: 단수 주어 recognition에 is로 정상

✅ ② learns to recognise: 단수 주어 a customer에 learns, 그 뒤 to부정사로 정상

❌ ③ having → has: 'but because the traveller ___ a good indication'에서 because가 이끄는 절에는 문장의 동사(정동사)가 반드시 있어야 해요. having(-ing)은 정동사가 될 수 없으므로 단수 주어 the traveller에 맞는 has가 와야 합니다 ←정답

✅ ④ will deliver: 조동사 will 뒤 동사원형 deliver로 정상
det.tip: 절(because ~)에는 정동사가 필요. the traveller has(O) / having(X)

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual ①<u>is travelling</u> for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of ②<u>what to expect</u> from any of their hotels worldwide. This ③<u>expectation reduces</u> the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver ④<u>a level of service what consumers would recognise</u> worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ what → that: 선행사 service가 있으므로 관계대명사 that(또는 which)이 맞고, what은 쓸 수 없다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① is travelling: 'an individual is travelling(개인이 여행하고 있다)'에서 현재진행형으로 정상

✅ ② what to expect: '의문사 + to부정사(무엇을 기대할지)'로 정상

✅ ③ expectation reduces: 단수 주어 This expectation에 reduces로 정상

❌ ④ what → that: 'a level of service ___ consumers would recognise'에서 앞에 선행사 service(명사)가 있어요. 선행사가 있으면 관계대명사 that(또는 which)을 써야 하고, 선행사 없이 '~인 것'을 뜻하는 what은 쓸 수 없어요 ←정답
det.tip: 선행사(service)가 있으면 관계대명사 that/which. what은 선행사가 없을 때만

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an ①<u>important</u> feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to ②<u>raise perceived risk</u>. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or ③<u>additional comfort</u> but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation ④<u>reduces the risk</u> of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 lower(낮추다)인데 raise(높이다)로 바꿈. 브랜드에 편안해지면 인지된 위험을 '낮춘다'는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① important(중요한): 인지가 '중요한' 특징이라는 맥락에 적절

❌ ② raise perceived risk(인지된 위험을 높이다) → lower perceived risk(인지된 위험을 낮추다): 브랜드에 편안해지면 위험 인식이 '낮아진다'는 문맥이므로 raise는 정반대 ←정답

✅ ③ additional comfort(추가적인 편안함): '추가적인 편안함' 때문이 아니라는 맥락에 적절

✅ ④ reduces the risk(위험을 줄이다): 기대가 위험을 '줄인다'는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: lower/reduce(낮추다·줄이다) ↔ raise/increase(높이다·늘리다)

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both ①<u>benefit</u> from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise ②<u>preferred</u> (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are ③<u>globally unknown</u>. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a ④<u>good indication</u> of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 원문은 recognised(인지된)인데 unknown(알려지지 않은)으로 바꿈. 전 세계적으로 '인지된' 호텔 체인이라는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① benefit(이득을 얻다): 고객과 기업 모두 '이득을 얻는다'는 맥락에 적절

✅ ② preferred(선호되는): 고객이 '선호하는' 브랜드를 알아본다는 맥락에 적절

❌ ③ globally unknown(전 세계적으로 알려지지 않은) → globally recognised(전 세계적으로 인지된): 여행자가 안심하고 묵는 이유는 그 체인이 '세계적으로 인지된' 곳이기 때문이므로 unknown은 정반대 ←정답

✅ ④ good indication(좋은 짐작): 무엇을 기대할지에 대한 '좋은 짐작'이라는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: globally recognised(세계적으로 인지된) ↔ globally unknown(세계적으로 알려지지 않은)

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are __________. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 전 세계적으로 인지된(globally recognised). 여행자가 택하는 것은 세계적으로 알려진 브랜드 호텔 체인이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① globally recognised(전 세계적으로 인지된): 처음 가는 지역에서도 안심할 수 있는 것은 그 체인이 '세계적으로 인지된' 곳이기 때문이라는 흐름에 부합 ←정답

❌ ② privately owned(개인 소유의): 소유 형태는 글의 논지와 무관

❌ ③ newly built(새로 지어진): 건물의 신축 여부는 본문에 없음

❌ ④ rarely visited(거의 방문되지 않는): '거의 안 가는' 곳은 안심의 근거가 되지 못해 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 다음 문장에서 '무엇을 기대할지 잘 안다'로 이어짐 → 세계적으로 인지된 체인

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or __________ but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 추가적인 편안함(additional comfort). 브랜드 호텔 선택이 반드시 더 나은 가치나 이것 때문은 아니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① additional comfort(추가적인 편안함): 'better value or ___(더 나은 가치나 ~)'의 병렬 구조에서 함께 부정되는 이유로 적절. 이어서 'but because(하지만 ~때문이다)'로 진짜 이유가 나옴 ←정답

❌ ② lower prices(더 낮은 가격): 'better value(더 나은 가치)'와 의미가 겹쳐 병렬로 어색함

❌ ③ faster service(더 빠른 서비스): 본문에 언급되지 않은 세부 사항

❌ ④ free meals(무료 식사): 본문에 등장하지 않는 소재
det.tip: not because [better value or ___] but because ~ → 추가적인 편안함

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ④ 소비자는 브랜드를 경험한 뒤 편안함을 느낀다 — 본문과 일치.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 첫 문장에서 고객과 기업 '모두' 이득을 얻는다고 했으므로 '기업에게만'은 틀림

❌ ② 본문은 반드시 더 저렴하기 때문은 아니라고(not necessarily) 했으므로 '항상 더 저렴'은 틀림

❌ ③ 브랜드 인지는 위험을 '낮춘다'고 했으므로 '높인다'는 반대

✅ ④ 'once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand'와 일치 ←정답
det.tip: 일치 문제는 본문이 긍정한 내용을 고른다

ch: 여행자는 브랜드 호텔이 항상 더 저렴하기 때문에 그곳을 택한다.
브랜드 인지는 오히려 여행의 위험을 높인다.
소비자는 브랜드를 경험한 뒤 그 브랜드에 편안함을 느끼는 경향이 있다.

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ① 경험을 쌓은 고객은 선호·비선호 브랜드를 모두 알아본다 — 본문과 일치.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 'a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands'와 일치. 선호 브랜드뿐 아니라 비선호 브랜드도 알아본다는 뜻 ←정답

❌ ② 브랜드 약속은 '전 세계 어디서나 알아볼 수준의 서비스'를 제공하는 것이므로 '지역마다 전혀 다른'은 반대

❌ ③ 본문은 낯선 지역 여행자가 오히려 브랜드 호텔을 '택한다'고 했으므로 '피한다'는 반대

❌ ④ 본문은 반드시 추가적인 편안함 때문은 아니라고 했으므로 '유일한 이유'는 틀림
det.tip: preferred as well as non-preferred = 선호 브랜드뿐 아니라 비선호 브랜드도

ch: 경험을 쌓은 고객은 선호 브랜드와 비선호 브랜드를 모두 알아보게 된다.
브랜드 약속은 지역마다 전혀 다른 서비스를 제공하는 것이다.
낯선 지역을 여행하는 사람은 브랜드 호텔을 피하는 경향이 있다.
추가적인 편안함이 브랜드 호텔을 택하는 유일한 이유다.

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ③ '반드시 더 나은 가격 때문'이라는 진술은 본문(반드시 그 때문은 아님)과 어긋난다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 'Customers and organisations both benefit from branding'과 일치

✅ ② 'This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises'와 일치

❌ ③ 본문은 브랜드 호텔 선택이 '반드시 더 나은 가치 때문은 아니다(not necessarily because ... better value)'라고 했으므로 '반드시 더 나은 가격 때문'은 불일치 ←정답

✅ ④ 'deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide'와 일치
det.tip: not necessarily(반드시 ~은 아니다)를 '반드시'로 뒤집은 선지가 불일치

ch: 브랜드화는 고객과 기업 양측 모두에게 이득이 된다.
브랜드에 대한 기대는 여행 중 불쾌한 일이 생길 위험을 줄인다.
여행자가 브랜드 호텔을 택하는 것은 반드시 더 나은 가격 때문이다.
브랜드 호텔은 전 세계 어디서나 소비자가 알아볼 만한 수준의 서비스를 약속한다.

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ 브랜드 인지가 소비자의 위험 부담을 줄여 주는 방식 — 글의 중심 주제.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 지역별 가격 차별화: 본문은 가격이 주된 이유가 아니라고 함

❌ ② 문화 충격 극복: 본문에서 다루지 않음

❌ ③ 로고 디자인의 매출 효과: 본문의 관심사가 아님

✅ ④ 브랜드에 대한 인지·친숙함이 소비자가 느끼는 위험을 줄여 준다는 것이 글 전체의 중심 생각 ←정답
det.tip: 주제 = 브랜드 인지 → 편안함·기대 → 인지된 위험 감소

questions.passage: Customers and organisations both benefit from branding. From the customer perspective, recognition is an important feature. With experience a customer learns to recognise preferred (as well as non-preferred) brands. For the consumer, once they have experienced the brand, they are likely to be comfortable with that brand and this tends to lower perceived risk. If, for example, an individual is travelling for the first time in the Far East, they might choose to stay at a branded chain of hotels that are globally recognised. This is not necessarily because these hotels offer better value or additional comfort but because the traveller has a good indication of what to expect from any of their hotels worldwide. This expectation reduces the risk of any unpleasant surprises during the trip. In effect, the brand promise of these hotel groups is that they will deliver a level of service that consumers would recognise worldwide.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 정답 ② '브랜드 인지는 친숙함을 통해 위험을 낮춘다'가 글의 핵심.
det.analysis:
❌ ① The Hidden Costs of Global Hotel Chains(글로벌 호텔 체인의 숨은 비용): 본문은 '비용'을 문제 삼지 않음

✅ ② Brand Recognition Lowers Risk Through Familiarity(브랜드 인지는 친숙함을 통해 위험을 낮춘다): 브랜드에 친숙해지면 인지된 위험이 낮아진다는 글의 핵심을 담음 ←정답

❌ ③ Why Cheaper Hotels Always Win Travellers(더 싼 호텔이 언제나 여행자를 얻는 이유): 본문은 가격이 반드시 이유는 아니라고 하므로 어긋남

❌ ④ Designing Logos That Customers Never Forget(고객이 결코 잊지 못할 로고 디자인하기): 로고 디자인은 본문의 주제가 아님
det.tip: 제목 = 친숙함(familiarity) → 위험 감소(lowering risk), 이 핵심을 담은 것
